390:t_022:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...I hate to go, but I do owe $$アウストラリス$$ a bit of loyalty.」

390:t_022:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But I'm happy anyway. Getting to fight such a fun opponent again!」

390:t_022:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Bye-bye, Darling! You too, $c! Next time, I'm going all out too!」

390:t_023:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「All units, fall back! Follow Lady $$エルーナ$$!」

390:t_024:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「It was like a storm...」

390:t_024:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「You said it... I felt like a bullfighter.」

390:t_024:3.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「...Incoming message from the $$マクロス・クォーター$$. They say they'll be joining us.」

390:t_025:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Looks like they made it through safely on their end, too.」

390:t_025:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「They're going to be shocked, though. When they find out who $$ストラウス$$ really is.」

390:t_025:2.en:
$n
「She's still an enemy we have to defeat, no matter what.」

390:t_025:3.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm with $n! There's no way I'm handing Darling over to someone like her!」

390:t_025:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
(That's a whole lot of personal grudge.)

390:t_025:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
(You shouldn't say that in front of $$メール$$.)

390:t_025:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't worry, $$メール$$. We're not about to lose to someone like her.」

390:t_026:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Even if it is, this guy seems to feel the same way I do.」

390:t_026:3.en:
$$ランド$$
(Looks like you've been putting up with a lot of things too, $$ガンレオン$$. I'd say that's why you couldn't bring out your power properly.)

390:t_026:4.en:
$$ランド$$
(But you and I both got past it. I'm counting on you from here on, too, partner.)

390:t_028:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Is she resonating with $$ランド$$'s $$スフィア$$ and powering up...?!」

390:t_028:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Take responsibility and do something about it, $$ランド$$!」

390:t_028:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Of course, that's the plan! I'll settle things with her myself!」

390:t_029:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「A blunder...! To show such a failing in front of Lady $$エルーナ$$!」

390:t_029:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Don't worry about it, don't worry about it! As long as you're alive, you can enjoy fighting again!」

390:t_029:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Y-yes, ma'am! Then, if you'll excuse me, I'll be heading out first!」

390:t_030:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's right. Never giving up is what makes $$ダバラーン$$ so great!」

390:t_030:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「And getting fired up to rack up battle honors right in front of the Commander, too. That's my right-hand man for you!」

390:t_030:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「That woman... is her mind a thick-skinned ox, too?!」

390:t_030:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Enemy or not, I feel a little bit sorry for that $$ダバラーン$$ guy...」

390:t_100:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's a shame, $$ストラウス$$! If you weren't our enemy, we might have gotten along pretty well, you know!」

390:t_100:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「You feel that way too, huh?! Then hurry up and quit $$サイデリアル$$ already!」

390:t_100:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you can't do that, you're my enemy! I'll take you on with everything I've got!!」

390:t_101:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Let's have plenty of fun, Darling!」

390:t_101:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Stay away from Darling! You're dangerous!」

390:t_101:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Heh... Are you that scared of the power of me and $$プレイアデス・タウラ$$?」

390:t_101:3.en:
$$メール$$
「That's not it! Going by looks alone, you're totally Darling's type!」

390:t_101:5.en:
$$メール$$
「Darling, quit ogling her and fight seriously!」

390:t_101:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah! I can't just leave someone who wages war with their desires at full throttle alone!」

390:t_101:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「OK, Darling! Let's love each other until one of us coughs up blood! With everything we've got!」

390:t_101:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's exactly the kind of thing I'm saying is wrong!!」

390:t_102:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$ランド・トラビス$$! You, I will bury with my own hands!!」

390:t_102:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「If a jab from $$メール$$ is enough to rattle you, you're no match for that woman, $$ダバラーン$$!」

390:t_102:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Silence! I will protect Lady $$エルーナ$$!!」

390:t_102:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Is she the type who needs protecting? Think about it for a second!!」

390:t_103:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Cute! You're so cute, $$セツコ$$!」

390:t_103:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Getting to fight a $$セツコ$$ like you makes me so happy! There's no way I'm handing you over to the likes of $$バルビエル$$!」

390:t_103:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm not a toy for you people!」

390:t_103:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Supreme Commander of the Empire's forces, $$エルーナルーナ$$! I'll defeat you here!」

390:t_103:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I like that, I like that! Hang in there a while, $$悲しみの乙女$$-chan!」

390:t_104:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Put up at least a little fight, $$揺れる天秤$$!」

390:t_104:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What the... You sure treat me a lot differently than $$ランド$$.」

390:t_104:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「In a man, power beats technique! Pretty boys and speed machines like you aren't my type!」

390:t_104:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Lucky me. $$スフィア$$ or no $$スフィア$$, looks like we just don't get along.」

390:t_104:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even a woman-hater like me hesitated a little about shooting a woman, but if that's how you want it, it's a breeze!」

390:t_104:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No holding back, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

390:t_104:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Aha! Maybe you'll be a little fun after all! Do your best, $$揺れる天秤$$!」

390:t_105:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Nice! An attack a hair's breadth from reckless and suicidal! I can feel the youth!」

390:t_105:1.en:
$n
「She's a better Reactor than I am! If I don't push a little harder, there's no chance of winning!」

390:t_105:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Heh... You know what really matters in a fight!」

390:t_105:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Hey Boy! Come over to $$サイデリアル$$... no, to $$ハイアデス$$! Fighting would be fun with you!」

390:t_105:4.en:
$n
「Sorry, but I don't like sloppy women who are weak to their desires.」

390:t_105:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Oh, is that so. Then don't be my comrade - be my rival, and show me a good time!」

390:t_105:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's your role, $$いがみ合う双子$$!!」
